json.overall_experience: This Team Lead found Pipedrive to be a decent tool for basic sales pipeline management within their large IT organization. While the visual pipeline was helpful for initial oversight, they encountered limitations when trying to create complex filters and custom objects to fit their specific team and company requirements. The platform felt less adaptable for a company of their size, leading to an average overall experience during their first few months of use.
